title: QatarEnergy announces/resumes LNG production in Qatar by April 30?
description:
QatarEnergy, a Qatari state-owned petroleum company, announced on March 2 that it would halt production of liquefied natural gas (LNG) due to military strikes on its operating facilities (see: https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/MediaCenter/Pages/newsdetails.aspx?ItemId=3892).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if QatarEnergy resumes production of liquefied natural gas at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar, or officially announces that such production has resumed or will resume, by April 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

QatarEnergy resuming the production of other halted products, including downstream LNG-related products, or resuming transportation of LNG without resuming production, will not alone count.

An official announcement that LNG production will resume at QatarEnergy LNG production facilities in Qatar must signal the end of the total LNG production halt effective immediately or on a specific date or clearly defined time window. Mere statements that production will resume at some undefined point in the future, or that production will resume once the halt has ended, will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from QatarEnergy (https://www.qatarenergy.qa/en/Pages/vHome.aspx); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: QatarEnergy's preparations to restart LNG production at Ras Laffan facilities following a March 2026 halt due to military attacks on key sites and subsequent force majeure declaration have driven trader consensus to near-certainty on resumption or announcement by April 30. Post-ceasefire developments in early April, including Reuters reports of mobilizing engineers, workers, and restarting two trains at QELNG North 1, signal de-escalation in regional tensions around the Strait of Hormuz, boosting confidence despite gradual scaling projected over months. With probabilities exceeding 90%, resolution hinges on an official QatarEnergy statement confirming end of total halt; potential disputes over partial operations, ongoing force majeure, or lack of primary source verification could still prompt a No outcome.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Winner
description:
This market will resolve according to the national team that wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the FIFA World Cup based on the rules of FIFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the knockout stage), this market will resolve immediately to “No”.

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is permanently canceled or has not been completed by October 13, 2026, 11:59 PM this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from FIFA, however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: BNK FEARX holds the edge in trader consensus for this LCK Rounds 1-2 BO3 series against DN SOOPers, buoyed by their clean 2-0 sweep over the same opponent in Week 2 and mid-table positioning amid DNS's grueling 16-series losing streak, including recent 0-2 defeats to HANJIN BRION and Gen.G. DN SOOPers' core roster—DuDu top, Pyosik jungle, Clozer mid, deokdam ADC, Peter support—struggles with macro execution and objective control, while BNK FEARX leverages Kellin's jungle pressure and VicLa's mid-lane stability in the current patch's skirmish-heavy meta. Head-to-head history and DNS's bottom-tier form underscore BNK's stylistic matchup advantages, though upsets remain possible in double round-robin play with Road to MSI implications looming.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

title: Indian Premier League: Sunrisers Hyderabad vs Kolkata Knight Riders
description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Sunrisers Hyderabad and Kolkata Knight Riders scheduled for May 3 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

eventMetadata.context_description: Sunrisers Hyderabad's five-match winning streak, including chases of 220+ against Mumbai Indians and Rajasthan Royals, positions them strongly atop trader consensus at home in Hyderabad, where the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium's flat, batting-friendly pitch with quick outfield favors high-scoring T20 run-fests and second-innings pursuits. Kolkata Knight Riders, buoyed by back-to-back wins after a slow start (two victories in eight), seek to exploit SRH's occasional middle-order wobbles via spinners Sunil Narine and Varun Chakaravarthy against explosive openers Travis Head and Abhishek Sharma (425 runs in nine innings). SRH's earlier 65-run thumping of KKR this season underscores their edge, though clear skies and 34-42°C heat pose no disruptions; toss winner likely bats second.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket favors California Governor Gavin Newsom at 26% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, driven by his recent New Hampshire book tour in an early primary state and positioning as a leading Trump administration critic, bolstering his executive experience and fundraising edge over former Vice President Kamala Harris (10%), who signaled interest in another run last week despite 2024 defeat baggage. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (8%) appeals to progressives, Jon Ossoff (7%) leverages Georgia swing-state credentials, and Pete Buttigieg/Josh Shapiro (4% each) offer Midwestern/Pennsylvania appeal. This wide-open field, diverging from polls showing Harris ahead, could consolidate via 2026 midterm gains for governors, key endorsements, or escalating policy clashes with the White House.

title: LoL: ThunderTalk Gaming vs LNG Esports (BO3) - LPL Group Nirvana
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between ThunderTalk Gaming and LNG Esports in the LPL Group Nirvana, initially scheduled for May 3 at 5:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "ThunderTalk Gaming" if ThunderTalk Gaming win the match against LNG Esports.

This market will resolve to "LNG Esports" if LNG Esports win the match against ThunderTalk Gaming.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Both Teams Slay a Dragon?
markets.description:
This market is about whether both teams slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. In League of Legends, elemental dragons (Infernal, Mountain, Ocean, Hextech, Chemtech, and Cloud) spawn in the dragon pit starting at 5:00 game time. After being slain, the next dragon spawns 5 minutes later. Once a team claims the Dragon Soul (by slaying four dragons), all subsequent dragon spawns become Elder Dragons.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if both ThunderTalk Gaming and LNG Esports each slay at least one elemental dragon during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if either team (or both teams) does not slay any elemental dragon during Game 1. Only elemental dragons count toward this market — Elder Dragon kills do not count.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether both teams had slain at least one elemental dragon prior to stoppage. If the condition was not met, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: In LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Nirvana's single round-robin, ThunderTalk Gaming (2-1, second place) faces LNG Esports (1-1, fourth) in a pivotal BO3 for top-four spots advancing to playoffs play-in, with bottom two eliminated. TT enters off a 1-2 loss to leader LGD Gaming on April 30—dominating map one 21-3 before faltering—following 2-0 over Ultra Prime and 2-1 versus Oh My God, showcasing midlaner Heru's carry potential amid their rebuilt 2026 roster. LNG rides a 2-0 rout of struggling Oh My God last week after a 1-2 EDG defeat, leveraging jungler Croco's tempo control despite historical 9-5 H2H edge (TT won latest March 28 clash 2-0). Patch 26.7 favors aggressive early plays, amplifying macro execution in this do-or-die group stage matchup.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim lead in trader consensus for the 2028 presidential election winner at 20.6%, bolstered by his strong CPAC straw poll performance in late March 2026—53% for the GOP nomination—and a UMass Lowell head-to-head poll from late March showing him edging California Governor Gavin Newsom 33%-30%. Newsom trails closely at 17.6%, buoyed by commanding early Democratic primary polls in California and youth surveys, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio sits at 10.2% after briefly surging as a betting favorite on other platforms amid his high-profile role. The fragmented field and absence of primaries keep the race tight, with 2026 midterms, official announcements, fundraising momentum like Vance's recent donor outreach, and Trump's approval ratings poised to create separation before Iowa caucuses in early 2028.

eventMetadata.context_description: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s high-profile April congressional testimonies, where he defended Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) reforms, vaccine guidance changes, and exposés on pharmaceutical influence, have driven trader consensus to a 49% implied probability for him as the 2028 Republican presidential nominee, edging Vice President J.D. Vance's 39.1% amid Vance's recent dips tied to Iran negotiation fallout and approval rating pressures. Secretary of State Marco Rubio holds 21.6% with diplomatic gains. This post-Trump succession contest stays tight due to Vance's incumbency edge versus RFK Jr.'s populist base appeal, with 2026 midterms, CPAC straw polls, and Trump endorsements likely tipping early primary dynamics in swing states.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli leads the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship with 75 points after three Grand Prix wins across Australia (P2), China (P1), and Japan (P1), edging teammate George Russell's 68 points from his Australian victory and consistent podiums, reflecting the squad's dominant race pace and front-row lockouts that have swept every race podium so far. Trader consensus prices Antonelli at 33% and Russell at 28.5% implied probability, bunched tightly due to their intra-team rivalry, shared superior Mercedes machinery, and Antonelli's back-to-back triumphs making him the youngest championship leader despite a Miami sprint penalty dropping him to P6 behind McLaren's 1-2. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc trails third at 55 points, while Red Bull's Max Verstappen and McLaren's Lando Norris lag further amid Mercedes' early-season edge, though a 21-race calendar leaves room for rivals to close via upgrades and consistency.

title: LoL: Ninjas in Pyjamas vs Bilibili Gaming (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:
This market refers to the LoL match between Ninjas in Pyjamas and Bilibili Gaming in the LPL Group Ascend, initially scheduled for May 3 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Ninjas in Pyjamas" if Ninjas in Pyjamas win the match against Bilibili Gaming.

This market will resolve to "Bilibili Gaming" if Bilibili Gaming win the match against Ninjas in Pyjamas.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.question: Game 1: Any Player Quadra Kill?
markets.description:
This market is about whether any player achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. In League of Legends, a Quadra Kill occurs when a single player kills 4 enemy champions in rapid succession.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Quadra Kill. A Penta Kill (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as a Quadra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Quadra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Quadra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Bilibili Gaming leads LPL 2026 Split 2 Group Ascend standings at 7-2, securing direct playoff positioning with recent dominant 2-0 sweeps over WBG and WE after their April 23 upset loss to NIP, highlighting resilient macro execution in Patch 26.7's early-game meta favoring picks like Xin Zhao and Jarvan IV. Ninjas in Pyjamas, mired at 4-4 on a two-match skid versus TES and JDG, stunned BLG 2-0 last time via HOYA's top-lane dominance and precise teamfighting from Guwon, Care, Assum, and Zhuo, but struggle with consistency. This BO3 rematch under Hard Fearless Draft emphasizes draft adaptability and map control in a high-stakes group stage clash.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus reflects near-certainty that the Iranian regime will endure through May 31, driven by its demonstrated resilience amid the 2026 Iran war and prior unrest. Security forces loyal to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) effectively suppressed the 2025–2026 protests via mass crackdowns and internet blackouts, quelling thousands of deaths without defections or loss of major cities. Following Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei's February assassination, Mojtaba Khamenei assumed leadership seamlessly by March, stabilizing command structures despite economic devastation from US naval blockades and $270 billion in war damage. A tense US-Iran ceasefire since early April holds, with no unified opposition or indicators of collapse per US intelligence assessments. Realistic shifts could arise from IRGC infighting, resumed large-scale airstrikes, or sudden mass defections, though the 28-day timeline limits feasibility.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Jordan Bardella slightly ahead of Édouard Philippe in first-round voting intentions for France's 2027 presidential election, reflecting late March 2026 polls where the National Rally leader topped scenarios at 34-38% amid widespread desire for political change following inconclusive municipal elections. Philippe, bolstered by his Le Havre mayoral reelection, trails closely at 18-25% as the center-right Horizons figure best positioned to defeat Bardella in runoff simulations (51.5-48.5%). The race remains tightly contested due to a fragmented field—divided left with Jean-Luc Mélenchon at 11-15%, multiple center-right rivals like Bruno Retailleau, and no party primaries yet—splitting anti-RN votes. Separation could arise from candidate designations by autumn 2026, potential center consolidation, or economic shocks before the April 2027 first round.

title: # of views of next MrBeast video on day 1?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of views the next YouTube video posted by MrBeast gets in the first 24 hours after being posted. This market may not resolve until the 24 hours are complete, regardless of whether a strike is reached earlier.

If MrBeast does not post a YouTube video by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers to MrBeast's next video to be posted. Shorts, previews, or other videos released other than the referenced video will not be considered.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 5 - May 12, 2026?

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil spot prices hover around $102 per barrel amid escalating US-Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz supply risks, driving Polymarket trader consensus toward near-certainty (100% implied probability) on breaching $100 this month. Recent EIA data revealed a sharp 6.2 million barrel draw in crude inventories to 459.5 million barrels for the week ended April 24, well below five-year averages, reinforcing backwardation in the futures curve with May contracts trading at a premium. OPEC+ countered with a modest 206,000 bpd output quota hike for May, offering limited relief against robust Q2 demand forecasts. Traders eye weekly EIA petroleum status reports and geopolitical flare-ups as pivotal catalysts through month-end.

title: Elon Musk # tweets May 1 - May 8, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from May 1 12:00 PM ET to May 8, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Cleveland Cavaliers host the Toronto Raptors in a decisive Eastern Conference first-round Game 7 today at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, with the series tied 3-3 after Toronto's dramatic 112-110 overtime victory in Game 6 on May 1, capped by RJ Barrett's bouncing game-winning 3-pointer. Cavaliers enter fully healthy per the latest injury report, leveraging home-court advantage, superior regular-season record (52-30 vs. 46-36), and stars like Donovan Mitchell and James Harden, while Raptors are without Immanuel Quickley (right hamstring strain) and list Brandon Ingram as questionable (right heel inflammation). Toronto's resilience without key pieces and Scottie Barnes' two-way impact fuel upset potential, but Cleveland's depth and 15-5 all-time playoff edge against Toronto shape trader consensus toward the hosts.

eventMetadata.context_description: Detroit Pistons host Orlando Magic in Game 7 of their Eastern Conference first-round playoff series, tied 3-3, with recent momentum swinging toward the No. 1 seed after a stunning 24-point comeback win in Game 6 (93-79 at Orlando). Cade Cunningham erupted for 32 points, dominating the fourth quarter as Magic's offense imploded (1-for-27 over final 16 minutes), erasing their 3-1 lead. Orlando rules out Franz Wagner (calf strain), a major scoring blow, with Jonathan Isaac doubtful (knee); Pistons list Kevin Huerter questionable (adductor) but clear Tobias Harris (ankle). Home-court advantage, Detroit's 60-22 regular-season dominance, and playoff resilience shape trader sentiment amid high-stakes pressure.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran negotiations for a permanent peace deal, mediated by Pakistan, hit an impasse after President Trump rejected Tehran's latest 14-point proposal on May 1, expressing dissatisfaction over insufficient nuclear curbs and inspections. A fragile ceasefire has held since early April following US Operation Epic Fury and a naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, with talks centering on sanctions relief, reopening the strait, and limiting Iran's enriched uranium stockpile and proxy support. Traders imply low-to-modest probabilities across near-term dates—June 30 leading at around 34%—due to persistent nuclear disputes and lack of mutual concessions, amid Iran's one-month negotiation deadline that could spur resumption or escalation.

title: Who will be confirmed as Fed Chair?
description:
This market will resolve according to the next individual formally confirmed as Chair of the Federal Reserve.

Formal confirmation as Chair of the Federal Reserve requires the Senate to confirm a nominee as Chair of the Federal Reserve. Recess appointments without Senate confirmation will not count. Senate confirmation of a listed individual as a member of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors will not alone qualify.

If no Senate confirmation for the position of Chair of the Federal Reserve has occurred by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the U.S. Senate; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trump's nominee Kevin Warsh, a former Federal Reserve Governor, commands overwhelming trader consensus at 99.7% implied probability for confirmation as Fed Chair following the Senate Banking Committee's 13-11 party-line vote on April 29 to advance his nomination after a April 21 confirmation hearing. The panel's approval resolved a brief Republican hold by Sen. Thom Tillis (R-NC), lifted after the DOJ ended its probe of outgoing Chair Jerome Powell, whose term expires May 15; Powell plans to remain a Board of Governors member through 2028. Sen. John Fetterman (D-PA) signaled support, bolstering prospects in the GOP-led Senate. Late-breaking scandals, withdrawals, or filibuster holds could disrupt, though barriers appear minimal given unified Republican backing and timeline pressures.
